Interaction Library

Whenever I had a spare moment, I built small samples of interactions I wanted to try, the way you jot ideas in a notebook. None of them made it into a real product; they just sat on my server. So I gathered a few and gave them a shelf: an interaction library.

The samples

  • Drag (Infinite 2D Grid): Meant for a photo journal. A wall of pictures with no edges, so nothing ends up on page two. DOM transforms and GSAP.
  • Repel (Cursor Wake): Meant for a portfolio index. The cursor parts the posters like a wake, and resting on one opens it. Three.js and a custom shader.
  • Skew (Velocity Reel): Meant for a photographer's portfolio. Photographs stretch with your speed and settle on one when you stop. Three.js and GLSL.
  • Dive (Depth Scroll): Meant for an online exhibition. Scrolling walks you through the room, and the cursor lets you lean to look around. Three.js.
  • Magnify (Index Lens): Meant for an exhibition's list of works. The cursor is the magnifier, and the line beneath it swells. Three.js and canvas-drawn type.
  • Bend (Scroll Bend): Meant for a studio's project list. A list that bends with the speed of your scroll, and draws itself flat when you stop. Three.js and a vertex shader.
  • Zoom (Mosaic Zoom): Meant for a photo archive. From afar the archive is one picture; go in and every square is a photograph. Canvas 2D.
  • Spin (Spiral Wind): Meant for a music label. Draw circles and a spiral of sleeves winds with your hand; stop, and the record in front slides out and turns. Canvas 2D.
  • Throw (Light Table): Meant for a photo editor's light table. Pick up a print and it swings round from where you hold it; throw it and it slides to rest, or bounces off the edge. Canvas 2D.
  • Draw (Drawn Line): Meant for an exhibition's interactive wall. Draw a line and photographs open out along it, coloured by where they fall, then fade in turn. Canvas 2D.
  • Strum (Strung Type): Meant for a type foundry's specimen. The library's name in single strokes: slowly the letters lean away; quickly you strum them. Canvas 2D.
